array.string: launchctl setenv ARCUS_API_KEY "$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -a devrev -s arcus-token -w)" launchctl setenv DEVREV_API_KEY "$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -a 'API Keys' -s 'DevRev API Key' -w)" launchctl setenv OPENCODE_ENABLE_PARALLEL true launchctl setenv OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_FILEWATCHER true launchctl setenv OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS true
